_comment: Source unit string (as printed in the AccessMedicine table, after source_corrections.json) -> UCUM code (https://ucum.org). Every unit of a shipped row needs an entry here; the pipeline aborts otherwise. 'Unit@PROPERTY' (LOINC PROPERTY of the matched term, e.g. 'mU/mL@ACnc') wins over the bare unit — needed where the source writes 'U' for international units. Conventions: per-day rates are written '/(24.h)' on both sides, as LOINC does; fractions of 1 are the UCUM unity '1'; 'of total Hb' on a percentage is dropped, on a content it becomes the annotation '{Hb}'.
